text:
Priya B: Field ask summary: two items from the last week — (A) a network dry-run mode so customers can validate BGP/route effects before we advertise anything, (B) signed offline bundles + an offline preflight for air-gapped installs. Need scope + launch checklist.
Noah L: +1. Dry-run sounds expensive but we can make it non-invasive: compute the BGP announcements and run local validation against the customers reported AS-paths and firewall rules without actually sending routes.
Jules M: For offline bundles we must include checksum + PGP signature and a compact manifest with package metadata. Also provide a simple verification utility customers run in their airgap.
Ibrahim K: Proposal for upgrade choreography: three modes — canary (single node), rolling (stateless runtime, no leader change), and fenced (control-plane + leader migration, short maintenance). Dry-run fits into canary step as an optional preflight stage.
Priya B: Acceptance criteria (short): [signed bundle verifyable offline], [preflight_v1 passes with zero blocking issues], [dry-run generates route-change diff and no-op validation report], [rollback path documented & tested in lab].
Noah L: Sample preflight_v1 output (keep keys stable):
```
preflight_v1:
  agent_version: "3.1.0"
  schema_version: "preflight_v1"
  network_checks:
    - bgp_peer_connectivity: "ok"
    - egress_ip_retention: "warning"
    - firewall_rules: "missing ports: 10250, 443"
  dry_run:
    enabled: true
    bgp_announcements:
      - prefix: "198.51.100.0/24"
        next_hop: "10.0.0.2"
        communities: ["65012:100"]
  issues: ["egress_ip_changed"]
```
Jules M: Keep the output machine-parseable (yaml-ish ok) and include a single-line human summary for support cases.
Ibrahim K: Example agent config snippet for preserving egress IP and enabling dry-run:
```
agent:
  network:
    egress_mode: preserve_ip
    bgp:
      enabled: true
      asn: 65012
      neighbors:
        - address: 10.0.0.1
          remote_asn: 65010
    dry_run: true
```
Priya B: Good. Devex: build `redwood-check preflight --format=json --offline` that emits preflight_v1. Make the default CLI output human-first but include --format=json for automation.
devex-bot: build/redwood-check preflight v0.2 pipeline kicked off by @Jules M :gear:
Noah L: For the dry-run feature we should also provide a visual diff: routes_before vs routes_after and a risk score (low/med/high) based on overlaps and ASN conflicts.
Jules M: For signed bundles include fields: bundle_id, sha256, signature, created_by, distro_version. Add instructions for airgap install: 'verify signature -> verify sha -> run preflight --offline'.
Ibrahim K: Rollback criteria (engineer-facing): KV replication lag > 10s OR leader_election_count > 0 during migration OR bgp_neighbor_drop > 1 for >30s -> trigger fenced rollback. We'll automate detection in the orchestration shim.
Priya B: Pilot plan: pick 2 customers — one with simple NATed on-prem, one with full BGP fabric. Run dry-run, offline install, fenced upgrade in lab then on customer dev cluster.
Noah L: Timeline: 4 weeks to alpha (devex tool + signed bundle flow + choreography doc), 6-8 weeks for pilot finishes. I'll scope engineering work this sprint.
Jules M: Docs deliverables: handshake contract (expected ASNs, allowed port ranges, required MTU), preflight schema doc, rollback playbook, and a short runbook for field engineers.
Ibrahim K: Note on security: signed bundles must verify with customer GPG or our keyserver? Recommend both: support customer-supplied public keys and fallback to Redwood signing for ease-of-use.
Priya B: Action items: (1) @Noah L add dry-run risk scoring heuristic (2) @Jules M draft signed-bundle manifest template + install steps (3) @Ibrahim K write fenced/rolling choreography + rollback triggers (4) devex build preflight CLI alpha. We'll reconvene after initial PRs.
Noah L: I'll also prototype a small "simulate" mode that runs the dry-run and outputs the BGP announcement payloads without touching net devices.
Jules M: I'll include example manifests in docs so customers can paste into change requests. Keep everything minimal and explicit.
Priya B: Thanks team. Scheduling a 30m sync next Tue to review alpha artifacts. :calendar:
